What the Council is

How this pack was reviewed

The is a layered review. Each layer is a group of expert "seats" that score the pack 0–10. It moves 7 → 5 → 3 → CDM and repeats until every seat is ≥8. Round 2 is complete: every layer passed. Round 3 scored this exec redesign (Strategic pair): Clarity 9 · Flow 8.5 — both PASS. The table below is still the Round 2 content scores.
